description.value: Moberly Lodge is a log-lodge-and-cabins property set on 12 acres near Golden, BC, offering a range of rooms from lodge suites to self-contained cabins such as the Columbia and Kicking Horse Cabins. Guests consistently highlight the spectacular mountain views, a hot tub, and home-cooked breakfasts served at the lodge. Its secluded, wooded setting makes it a characterful overnight option for cyclists exploring the Rocky Mountain Trench and Kicking Horse corridor.
